items.title: Malicious Browser Extensions Could Use Claude Dispatch to Run Code on Users' Computers
items.reason: Working PoC shows a malicious/compromised browser extension on claude.ai can hijack Claude Desktop's Dispatch feature to run arbitrary commands (demoed via npm install -> Calculator launch); Anthropic is retiring Dispatch over the design, not a patch.
key_facts: Forever Security PoC: script on claude.ai opens Dispatch, sends prompts, auto-clicks 'Allow' every second, installs an npm package whose install script opens Calculator

Reported May 14; Anthropic called it a duplicate of an internally-found issue on May 19
Anthropic is retiring Dispatch (target Oct 2026) rather than fixing the underlying design; Claude Code Remote Control/Cowork flagged as possibly similar, untested
